versionRule: This is a private implementation revision, not a normative BDP identity law. Any edit to a pinned interpretation module or dependency lock requires conscious review of admission, graph shape, resolution, built-in closure, error and budget behavior. A behavior-changing interpretation revision must increment SCHEMA_GRAPH_POLICY and refresh these source pins together. A behavior-preserving edit may retain the policy only with an explicit reviewed justification. Do not blindly regenerate pins to make a failing test pass. Tests, comments and metadata pins are a review tripwire, not a runtime source-hash identity or a proof of complete transitive semantic closure.
revision2: Adds safe bound validation, dependency-load containment, built-in aggregate integrity accounting, and consistent reference-error locations. These interpretation/admission changes receive a new private identity revision even where successful structural graph output is unchanged.
metadataReview: The Read parser now projects a missing common metadata member as an empty object in returned Resource records and recursively in owned Links, and the protocol bundle admits the new metadata member and distinguishes current Read validators from legacy-compatible retained/Event record definitions. The installed schema graph indexer imports only the shared ProtocolArtifactValidationError and lossless JSON/Type conformance helpers; it does not parse Resource records or use BDP Resource schemas as graph inputs. Graph node, URI, reference, built-in, budget and refusal behavior is unchanged, so private schema-resource-index-2 is retained. This source-pin refresh records that review, not a claim that Read wire semantics are unchanged.
scope: Pins owning graph modules, artifact ingestion, lossless JSON decoder, descriptor/canonical-URI and conformance parsing modules, protocol export surface and adjacent value/schema/error helpers, normative descriptor schema, and dependency lock. Missing $schema uses the private 2020-12 default; legacy additionalItems and bare id remain opaque, with their legacy semantics unsupported. No claim that every transitive initializer or external runtime is closed.
builtinAccounting: Every build indexes the eight immutable built-ins and charges their work under the joint graph budget. The aggregate check is repeated and charged; there is no memoized global graph or runtime engine readiness claim.
attributionReview: Carried attribution now uses basis writer-supplied or unknown instead of status claimed or unknown in the public protocol and schema. The installed schema graph indexer does not interpret Resource attribution or use Bead/Link records as schema graph inputs. Its graph shape, resolution, built-in closure, budget and refusal behavior are unchanged; retain private schema-resource-index-2 while recording the new protocol source pins.
revisionProvenanceReview: The common Resource envelope consolidates actor attribution and History context as revisionProvenance, with actor id/basis and unchanged context value states. Protocol export names and the Resource schema change; installed-schema-graph and its shape/URI/builtin/contract modules do not consume Resource envelopes or the provenance parsers. No graph interpretation, Type descriptor admission, resolution, built-in closure, error or budget behavior changes. Retain private schema-resource-index-2; refreshed source pins record this reviewed boundary, not unchanged public wire semantics.
metadataFreezeReview: Freezing only synthesized empty Resource metadata closes a mutable parsed-snapshot escape. Installed schema graph interpretation does not call Resource record projection; descriptor admission, graph shape, resolution, built-in closure, errors and budgets are unchanged. Native independent review confirmed that scope at source0172c16. Retain schema-resource-index-2 and refresh only the read-values source pin; this is not a Read conformance reseal.
revisionProvenanceOutputReview: Require a nonempty output revisionProvenance envelope; the input envelope still admits an empty object. This tightens Resource/History/Event wire validation only. Installed schema graph indexing consumes lossless schema artifacts and Type descriptor contracts, not Resource provenance definitions. No graph shape, descriptor admission, URI/reference resolution, built-in closure, errors or budgets change; retain schema-resource-index-2 and refresh the protocol bundle source pin in this private policy. That source-pin refresh alone is not a Read evidence reseal: the changed sealed revisionProvenance definition requires a newly computed Read projection pin and an actual fresh two-target Read cohort before the Read evidence gate can pass.
diagnosticDocumentReview: The validationDiagnostic wire schema adds a closed optional document discriminator, and numeric admission preserves that field before its existing UTF-8 diagnostic accounting. Installed schema graph indexing uses lossless JSON decoding, not numeric diagnostic formatting, and the changed validationDiagnostic definition is not part of the Type descriptor or installed graph interpretation. Graph nodes, references, built-ins, budgets and refusal rules are unchanged; retain schema-resource-index-2 and refresh only these two reviewed source pins. This is not a Read conformance reseal.
transactionalDiscoveryReview: The protocol index adds Transactional discovery and Operation Directory parser/type exports. Their AJV instance and schema validators are private and initialized only when these parsers are called; the installed schema graph indexer does not call them. Existing descriptor admission, graph shape, URI/reference resolution, built-in closure, error and budget behavior are unchanged. Retain schema-resource-index-2 after reviewing these exports and their initializer; refresh only the protocol index pin. This is not discovery serving admission or a profile evidence reseal.
